mirages.claim: Preview for MENU step renders 'тіло' (body) via VariableTemplateRenderer.render (tech-spec lines 21, 54, 109)
mirages.reality: FunnelStep has no separate 'body' field; MENU text lives in the existing 'text' field (FunnelStep.text). The renderer is applied to text/caption. 'тіло'/'body' is a descriptive UI label, not a code field name — render call is sound against the real field.

mirages.claim: Stop-all scopes bulk-cancel by projectId+funnelId, presented as a faithful mirror of FunnelService.delete (tech-spec lines 52, 99, 222)
mirages.reality: FunnelService.delete (lines 180-191) scopes its updateMulti by funnelId ONLY (no projectId in the criteria). The tech-spec explicitly frames the added projectId scope as fail-closed tenant hardening (Decision 7), so this is an intentional deviation, not a false claim — but the word 'дзеркало/mirror' slightly overstates fidelity. status=cancelled + stepRunStatus=done + updatedAt set is byte-identical.
